pdflatex not found. Please select a different --pdf-engine or install pdflatex

ls: /tmp/val.pdf: No such file or directory

observation.command:
cd /workspace && docker exec workspace-tika-1 sh -c 'printf "

Validation PDF

This is a text-based PDF used to verify pdftotext extraction by open_taki.

" > /tmp/src.html && pandoc /tmp/src.html -o /tmp/val.pdf 2>&1; ls -la /tmp/val.pdf' && echo "=== copy out ===" && docker cp workspace-tika-1:/tmp/val.pdf /tmp/val.pdf && ls -la /tmp/val.pdf && echo "=== PDF extraction via open_taki ===" && curl -sS -w '\nHTTP:%{http_code}\n' -X PUT -H 'Content-Type: application/pdf' --data-binary @/tmp/val.pdf http://localhost:9998/rmeta/text 2>&1 | head -5
